svg.title: Neurosurgical emergencies: headache, coma, a new deficit or trauma mean pressure in a closed skull; protect the airway, image, and decompress according to what takes up the space: an epidural or acute subdural hematoma, a ruptured aneurysm, a tumour with edema, or hydrocephalus

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Headache · coma · new neurological deficit · trauma: the cause is PRESSURE

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: examine to LOCALIZE: Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS), PUPILS, cranial nerves, power side to side, sensory level

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: INTUBATE for GCS < 9 (airway protection) → image → emergency neurosurgery = DECOMPRESSION
